name: Schelklingen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Schelklingen (three red bends on white).
history: Municipal flag of Schelklingen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Schelklingen arms — red bends on white
